data.body:
Held-out test contract card (frozen before test code):
- authoritative_contract: explicit session requirement and this ticket ACs—preserve all four OS/Python cells, both pytest tiers, and the unchanged branch/fail-under gate; eliminate only duplicate tracing.
- trigger_preconditions: parse the real reusable workflow with its declared matrix/exclusions and default/integration step commands.
- production_path: `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` matrix expansion plus the coverage argument expression consumed by GitHub Actions.
- test_tier: workflow configuration-contract unit test; a lower pure helper test cannot observe the shipped YAML matrix/expression.
- observable_postcondition: expanded cells are exactly Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13; every cell retains default and integration tier commands; only Ubuntu 3.13 resolves to both coverage flags, all other cells resolve to neither; truthy branch is non-empty flags and the final fallback is the empty string.
- negative_control: Ubuntu 3.11, Ubuntu 3.12, and macOS 3.13 must all remain test-bearing but uninstrumented.
- ci_gate: `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`; the file runs inside every default-suite matrix cell.
